tools.description: Optional subset of tools to inspect. Defaults to all supported entries.

toolchainRoot.description: Optional container-visible toolchain root override. Defaults to MATOS_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_CONTAINER_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_COMPUTE_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER_ROOT, /opt/matos-tools, then the configured host toolchain root.

probe.description: Whether to run lightweight version/import probes. Defaults to true.
